verses.english: I swear by this town,
as you reside in this town;
[and] by the father and him whom he begot:
certainly We created man in travail.

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
verses.english: Does he suppose that no one will ever have power over him?
verses.transliteration_html: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun
verses.transliteration_text: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun

verses.english: He says, ‘I have squandered immense wealth.’
Does he suppose that no one sees him?
Have We not made for him two eyes,
a tongue, and two lips,
and shown him the two paths [of good and evil]?
Yet he has not embarked upon the uphill task.
And what will show you what is the uphill task?
[It is] the freeing of a slave,

verses.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
verses.english: or feeding, during days of [general] starvation,
verses.transliteration_text: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin

verses.english: an orphan among relatives
or a needy man in desolation,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
verses.english: while being one of those who have faith and enjoin one another to patience, and enjoin one another to compassion.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati

verses.english: They are the People of the Right Hand.

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.english: But those who defy Our signs, they are the People of the Left Hand.
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

verses.english: A closed Fire will be [imposed] upon them.
